cases.fullTitle: Positive Funding collection [F01] collects SHORT PnL 600000 and Funding 20 with a fixed two-account epoch
targets: exact origin+10 and origin+50 timestamps for both accounts
independent rational Funding USD18=20000000000000/1; debt/claim=20/1 raw
SHORT plan/seal/budget/integer only; no LONG payment or withdrawal
balances/LP shares/allowances/LONG state unchanged; authorizations zero
fixed block raw query/canonical ABI/saved-value comparison

scope: one separate local research scenario; no payable rights, dedicated consumption Receipt, terminal or complete ledger claim

artifactStates.setupFailure: Require attempted+failure records; valid matching terminal/partial/Mocha records must prove started=false; reject observation files
artifactStates.observationStarted: started=true set before first file creation; require observationAttempted even on creation/write failure
artifactStates.observationFailure: Require observationFailed in addition to attempted and observationAttempted; require case-failure when overall F01 fails
artifactStates.verificationNotRunOrFailed: Do not demand a success validation artifact; reject an unexpected positive-validation.json
artifactStates.verificationPassed: Require and parse positive-validation.json; state PASS and SHA-256 must match positive-funding.json even if cleanup fails
artifactStates.cleanupFailureAfterObservationSuccess: Keep all observationAttempted and validationPassed evidence; overall case FAIL does not downgrade observation to NOT_RUN
artifactStates.unreadableOrConflicting: UNKNOWN plus collection failure; missing/invalid records do not prove NOT_RUN
artifactStates.scope: Evidence-state metadata only; no change to arithmetic/getters/lifetime or test counts
